summary: This clinical study will test how well the study drug zenagamtide lowers blood sugar and body weight compared to semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes. The sponsor Novo Nordisk A/S plans to enroll 1200 participants for this Phase 3 trial. The status of the study is Not yet recruiting. Participants will receive weekly injections under the skin of either zenagamtide, semaglutide, or a placebo.
